## Purpose
Pills and metadata for rules.

## Responsibilities
- `Tone` and `Pill`.
- `OUTCOME_META` / `OutcomePill` (passed, applied, fixed, warned, blocked).
- `ENFORCEMENT_META` / `EnforcementPill` (block, warn, fix).
- `SOURCE_META` / `SourcePill` (who added the rule).
- `CATEGORY_META` / `CATEGORY_ORDER` and `RuleIcon` (category icons, built-in and selectable).
